name: Llywelyn I
text: Llywelyn I is the princely master of the faithful hound in the well-known Welsh folk-tale of Bedd Gelert. The story is sometimes told of either Llywelyn ap Iorwerth or Llywelyn ap Gruffud, the two most famous bearers of the name.

attributes.attribute: princely master of the dog Bedall Gelert
